summary: Iteration 80 - Product Evolution (Bitácora) and Integration Report Grouping features. All 23/23 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Integration Report page has 4 grouping options (Sin Agrupar, Por Banco, Por Producto, Por Fase), Bank Detail page shows evolution button (FileText icon) on integrations, Evolution modal works with create/edit/delete functionality.

issues: React hydration warning about <span> in <tbody> - internal tooling issue, not affecting functionality

seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed evolution entries
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 80 complete. Features tested: 1) GET /api/banks/integrations/report - flat mode returns list, group_by=bank|product|phase returns dict with groups structure {group_by, total, groups: {key: {label, count, items}}}. 2) POST /api/banks/{bank_id}/integrations/{integration_id}/evolution - creates entry with entry_id (pev_xxx), comment, phase, date, created_at. 3) GET .../evolution - returns entries sorted by date descending. 4) PATCH .../evolution/{entry_id} - updates entry, adds updated_at. 5) DELETE .../evolution/{entry_id} - removes entry. Frontend: IntegrationReport page at /banks/integrations/report shows grouping toolbar with data-testid='group-by-{none|bank|product|phase}', grouped view has section headers with counts. BankDetail page has evolution button (data-testid='evo-btn-{integration_id}'), modal (data-testid='product-evolution-modal') shows form with product name, phase badge, comment textarea (data-testid='product-evo-comment'), phase select, date input, and timeline with edit/delete icons per entry.
